About Me

Marc Palmhøj is a Copenhagen based visual designer and 3D artist. Crafting imagery, motion, and visual concepts through a futuristic lens, driven by experimentation and research.

In doing so, Palmhøj uses a range of high-end 3D software and design tools in his workflow from Houdini and Touchdesigner  to Adobe Suite and After Effects.
